failures.result: The first independent region auditor reconstructs an Arb ball from serialized exact midpoint/radius data before comparing its upper endpoint. Additional rounding falsely rejects a valid stored bound. It emits no audit JSON. A controlled 1024-bit diagnosis finds 108 reconstruction false rejections among 1936 comparisons and zero exact endpoint violations. Separate v2 compares exact rational midpoint-plus-radius endpoints. The certificate and its bounds are unchanged.

The first recursive verifier passes the decoder record to the proposal generator, which expects the midpoint/preconditioner record. It fails with KeyError full_rank_proposal before producing verification output. Separate v2 corrects the input argument and reproduces the original error as a control. All scientific certificates are unchanged.

source_policy: Executed sources, the original failed auditor and its actual receipt remain immutable. The final recursive verifier runs after packaging, preserves a separate external receipt and supplies its exact stdout as Verification.json.
runtime: No package acquisition, version change or new source roots. Existing pinned Python, FLINT and Lean/mathlib environments are reused.
independence: Complex Hermite jets and real derivative polynomials provide distinct analytic calculations. Exact elimination and positive Neumann sums provide distinct stability constructions. Both interval methods share FLINT; field classification and finite-source premises are inherited.
negative_results: Larger-radius failed sufficient bounds and two excluded signed inverse target pairs are preserved with their limited meanings. Neither establishes global noninjectivity or a universal noise impossibility threshold.
